subject: USE statement
notes: DeclBindUseF3 applies the test on exactly the operand the format calls exception-name-2 -- `entry.fileName().Length > 0`, i.e. only the `exception-name-2 {FILE file-name-2}...` alternative, never the bare exception-name-1 alternative -- and raises COBOL0715 "FILE may be specified only with an exception-name beginning 'EC-I-O'" citing 14.9.49.3 SR13. The predicate is `name.StartsWith("EC-I-O", OrdinalIgnoreCase)`, which is literally 'beginning with EC-I-O' and correctly admits the level-2 name EC-I-O itself as well as every EC-I-O-* level-3 name. Probes: SR13BAD.cob (`USE AFTER EC EC-BOUND FILE F1.`) -> COBOL0715, correct; SR5F3.cob (`USE AFTER EC EC-I-O FILE F1 FILE F2.`) -> clean, so the level-2 EC-I-O head is not over-rejected; SR14DUP.cob (`... EC-I-O-AT-END FILE F1.`) -> accepted on the first occurrence. The name itself is resolved through the one EcNameResolution funnel before this test, so a misspelt name draws its own 0711/0878/1636 rather than a misleading SR13. The named test is spec-derived (asserts the SR13 diagnostic on `USE AFTER EXCEPTION CONDITION EC-SIZE FILE TF.`).
